chunks: And the dwellers of the Wood and the people of Tubba'. Each of them denied the apostles. So My threat became a reality.

key_terms.أَصْحَابُ الْأَيْكَةِ: The dwellers of the Wood, a people mentioned in the Quran who denied Prophet Hud
key_terms.قَوْمُ تُبَّعٍ: The people of Tubba', referring to the Himyarite kings of Yemen

ai.seo_question: Who were the People of the Wood and the people of Tubba' in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, the 'Ashab al-Aykah' are often identified as the tribe of Midian who rejected Prophet Shu'ayb, while Qaum Tubba' refers to the Himyarite kings of Yemen, illustrating the universal pattern of rejecting divine guidance across different eras and geographies. This verse underscores the inevitability of divine retribution for those who persist in denial, serving as a warning to the contemporaries of the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) and a testament to the consistency of God's covenant with the messengers.
